groups.title: SK Telecom AI factory deployment
groups.question: Will the first SK Telecom AI factory using NVIDIA Vera Rubin come online by 2027-12-31?
groups.scope: The timing of the first SK Telecom AI factory using Vera Rubin coming online; distinct from NVIDIA's production-shipment timing.

members.reason: C1 measures FY2027 revenue from H200 products for China-based customers, directly matching this group's market-access and revenue question.
C2 measures whether Vera Rubin production shipments commence by the end of 2026, directly matching this group's shipment-timing question.
c1 measures whether the first SK Telecom AI factory using Vera Rubin comes online by the stated deadline, matching this group's deployment question.

views.looks_at: Whether NVIDIA records revenue from H200 products for China-based customers in FY2027.
views.question: Will NVIDIA generate any revenue from H200 products for China-based customers in FY2027?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA reports any revenue from H200 products for China-based customers during FY2027.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA reports no revenue from H200 products for China-based customers during FY2027.

views.looks_at: Whether NVIDIA commences Vera Rubin production shipments during calendar 2026 H2.

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA commences Vera Rubin production shipments on or before 2026-12-31.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA has not commenced Vera Rubin production shipments by 2026-12-31.
